take.title_zh: 分層模型戰開打，Figma 把 AI 直接嵌進畫布
take.title_en: The Tiered-Model Race Meets AI-Native Canvas Design
take.body_zh:
OpenAI 本週推出 GPT-5.6 三分層版 Sol、Terra、Luna，緊接 xAI Grok 4.5，兩家轉向同世代多種算力／成本策略，不再只拼單一旗艦分數。

同時 Figma 在 Config 2026 把 AI 生成、動效與程式碼收進畫布，State of Designer 報告點出 AI 正模糊 PM、工程與設計分工。模型分層、工具生成並進，設計師價值轉向判斷對。
take.body_en:
This week's AI news came in waves: OpenAI shipped GPT-5.6 as three tiers — Sol, Terra, Luna — right on the heels of xAI's Grok 4.5, with both labs now competing on cost/performance tiers within a single generation rather than a single flagship score. For designers, picking a model is starting to feel like picking a cloud plan: speed, cost, and task complexity all matter now.

Meanwhile Figma used Config 2026 to push AI generation directly into the canvas — Code Layers, Motion, and Weave — and its State of the Designer report says AI is blurring the lines between PMs, engineers, and designers. As models fragment into tiers and tools get generative by default, a designer's edge shifts faster from execution accuracy to judgment.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 發布 GPT-5.6 三分層模型 Sol／Terra／Luna
articles.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6 Lineup: Sol, Terra, Luna
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 本週四發布 GPT-5.6 系列，分三層級：旗艦版 Sol、中階版 Terra、低成本快速版 Luna，讓開發者依成本效能彈性選用，同步擴大全球預覽存取。此舉緊跟 xAI 發布 Grok 4.5，反映業界正從單一旗艦競賽轉向同世代多種算力／成本組合的產品策略。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI publicly launched the GPT-5.6 family this Thursday, split into three tiers: Sol as the new flagship, Terra as a midrange option for everyday work, and Luna as a fast, low-cost tier. It's OpenAI's first simultaneous three-tier release, letting developers pick based on cost and performance needs, alongside expanded global preview access. The launch follows closely on xAI's Grok 4.5, signaling a shift from single-flagship benchmark races toward multi-tier product lineups within one generation.
articles.take_zh: 分層發布比單一旗艦更貼近實際採購決策，開發者不用再為省成本犧牲品質。但三個版本同時上線也考驗文件與定位是否清楚，避免選擇困難反而拖慢導入速度。
articles.take_en: Tiered releases map better to real procurement decisions than a single flagship. The risk is clarity — three simultaneous SKUs need crisp positioning, or choice overload could slow adoption instead of speeding it up.

articles.title_zh: xAI 推出 Grok 4.5，主打程式協作與代理任務
articles.title_en: xAI Ships Grok 4.5, Targets Coding and Agentic Work
articles.summary_zh: xAI 本週三發布新一代模型 Grok 4.5，定位為針對程式協作、代理型任務與知識工作優化，訓練過程強調對 cursor 類編輯流程的支援。這是 Grok 系列最貼近開發者日常工作流的一次更新，緊接在 OpenAI 發布 GPT-5.6 前一天登場，凸顯前沿模型競爭已進入近乎每週都有新動作的節奏。
articles.summary_en: xAI released Grok 4.5 on Wednesday, positioned as a model optimized for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, with training tuned toward cursor-style editing workflows. It's Grok's most workflow-focused update yet, landing just a day before OpenAI's GPT-5.6 rollout — a near back-to-back cadence that shows how frontier-model competition has compressed into an almost weekly rhythm of new releases and announcements.
articles.take_zh: 把程式協作當主打賣點，說明 agentic coding 已是各家必爭戰場而非加分項。發布節奏加快，也意味設計師與 PM 選型的窗口期更短。
articles.take_en: Leading with coding and agentic tasks confirms this is now table stakes, not a differentiator. The tightening release cadence also means shorter evaluation windows for teams choosing which model to build on.

articles.title_zh: Figma Config 2026：Code Layers、Motion 與 Weave 正式上線
articles.title_en: Figma Config 2026: Code Layers, Motion, and Weave Land
articles.summary_zh: Figma 在 Config 2026 公布重磅更新：Code Layers 讓圖層一鍵轉為可互動程式碼；Motion 提供含關鍵影格的時間軸動效編輯；Weave 把 AI 生成工具整合進畫布。三項功能把設計、動效、程式碼、生成收進同一介面，是近年最大幅度的產品擴張。
articles.summary_en: At Config 2026, Figma unveiled Code Layers — turning any design layer into an interactive code layer with one click or a prompt — Motion, a full animation timeline with keyframes and presets, and Weave, which brings AI generation directly into the canvas. Together they collapse design, motion, code, and AI generation into a single interface, marking one of Figma's biggest product-scope expansions in recent years.
articles.take_zh: 把程式碼、動效與生成式 AI 都收進同一畫布，意味著「設計稿」和「可交付產品」的界線持續模糊。對設計師來說，工具能力擴張的速度可能已經超過團隊分工調整的速度。
articles.take_en: Folding code, motion, and generative AI into one canvas keeps blurring the line between a design file and a shippable product. Tooling capability may now be outpacing how fast teams can rework their own division of labor.

articles.title_zh: Figma《State of the Designer 2026》：AI 正模糊 PM／工程／設計分工
articles.title_en: Figma's State of the Designer 2026: AI Blurs Role Lines
articles.summary_zh: Figma 發布《State of Designer 2026》報告，指出 AI 正瓦解開發角色邊界：PM、工程師被更早拉進設計流程，UX 設計師則推往更高層次策略思考。報告引用資料指出 82.3% 的 UI 設計師用 Figma，82.6% 每週活躍，是產品開發的預設中樞。
articles.summary_en: Figma's annual State of the Designer 2026 report finds AI tools are dissolving traditional role boundaries in product development — pulling PMs and engineers into the design process earlier while pushing UX designers toward higher-order strategic thinking rather than pure execution. The report also cites UX Tools data showing 82.3% of UI designers use Figma, with 82.6% of them weekly, cementing it as the default hub for product collaboration.
articles.take_zh: 分工界線模糊化對資深設計師是機會（承接更多策略性工作），對只做執行端的角色則是警訊。這份報告值得拿來和自己團隊的協作流程對照，看看角色分工是否已經落後現實。
articles.take_en: Blurring role lines is an opportunity for designers who can move upstream into strategy, but a warning sign for anyone doing pure execution work. Worth benchmarking your own team's workflow against this to see if role definitions have fallen behind reality.
